command.name: Unbreakable Loyalty
verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to increase Strength (+18%, enhanced by Instinct) and Initiative (+9%, enhanced by Instinct) of the other Ally with highest Strength for 2 rounds.
Rounds 2, 4, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (+50%). At 6+ Stars apply Recovery to 2 other Allies in any lane (+30%, doubled with Resistance).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Presence
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Recovery Dealt by +15% and Instinct by +25. Increase Fire Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Crushing Force
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase the Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and the Tactical Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +9% for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Dragon's Insight
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -4% and increase your Instinct by +5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Loyal Shield
habits.verbatim: Unbreakable Loyalty gains: Rounds 2, 4, 7, 9: Apply Recovery to 2 other Allies in any lane (Recovery Rate: +30%, enhanced by Instinct). The amount of Recovery is doubled if the target has Resistance (Recovery Rate: +60%, enhanced by Instinct).

habits.name: Unbroken Devotion
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Recovery Received by +15% of 2 other Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Sneak Attack
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 14% chance to increase Physical Damage Dealt by +10% and grant First-Strike to the Other Ally with the highest Strength for 2 round(s).
